images.title: Add 3,486 and 2,729
images.purpose: Show that adding large numbers uses the same regrouping steps as small numbers.
images.composition: A thousands, hundreds, tens and ones chart for 3,486 + 2,729 with three carry circles and the sum 6,215.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A place value chart, 4 columns each 220 px wide, x 288 to 1168. Column header row y 70 to 140 with the names Thousands, Hundreds, Tens, Ones in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (38 px), each centred in its column. The chart body is a table with 1 header row and 4 rows, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px, with thin construction grey #6B7280 lines (2 px) between the columns. Row 1 (carry row) y 140 to 215; row 2 (first number) y 215 to 315; row 3 (second number) y 315 to 415; a thick dark rule (6 px) at y 425 across the chart; row 4 (answer row) y 435 to 535. In the first number row (centre y 265) the digits, left to right, are: 3 at x 398; 4 at x 618; 8 at x 838; 6 at x 1058, each in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). In the second number row (centre y 365) the digits, left to right, are: 2 at x 398; 7 at x 618; 2 at x 838; 9 at x 1058, each in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). In the answer row (centre y 485) the digits, left to right, are: 6 at x 398; 2 at x 618; 1 at x 838; 5 at x 1058, each in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). A + sign in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px) stands at x 228, y 365, to the left of the second number. In the carry row there are exactly 3 circles: a circle of 64 px diameter outlined green #009E73 (4 px) at x 398, y 178 holding 1; a circle of 64 px diameter outlined green #009E73 (4 px) at x 618, y 178 holding 1; a circle of 64 px diameter outlined green #009E73 (4 px) at x 838, y 178 holding 1. The circle over the Hundreds column holds the 1 regrouped from 10 tens, the circle over the Thousands column holds the 1 regrouped from 10 hundreds, and the circle over the Tens column holds the 1 regrouped from 10 ones.  Under the chart, centred at x 728, y 650, the line 3,486 + 2,729 = 6,215 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px), the largest text in the frame. No other text. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Add one place at a time and regroup 10 as 1 of the next place: 3,486 + 2,729 = 6,215.
images.description: A chart with 3,486 above 2,729, three carries of 1 and the sum 6,215.
images.context: Concept image for Large Numbers: Adding, Then Subtracting, Section A, using the example's own numbers (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Say that the digits are lined up from the right, ones under ones, and that the place names are only a help. Move from the ones to the thousands, pointing at each carry. The slip to watch: writing a two digit total in one place.

images.title: Subtract 2,758 from 6,402
images.purpose: Show subtraction of large numbers with regrouping across a zero.
images.composition: A thousands, hundreds, tens and ones chart for 6,402 − 2,758 with four regroup marks and the difference 3,644.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A place value chart, 4 columns each 220 px wide, x 288 to 1168. Column header row y 70 to 140 with the names Thousands, Hundreds, Tens, Ones in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (38 px), each centred in its column. The chart body is a table with 1 header row and 4 rows, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px, with thin construction grey #6B7280 lines (2 px) between the columns. Row 1 (carry row) y 140 to 215; row 2 (first number) y 215 to 315; row 3 (second number) y 315 to 415; a thick dark rule (6 px) at y 425 across the chart; row 4 (answer row) y 435 to 535. In the first number row (centre y 265) the digits, left to right, are: 6 at x 398; 4 at x 618; 0 at x 838; 2 at x 1058, each in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). In the second number row (centre y 365) the digits, left to right, are: 2 at x 398; 7 at x 618; 5 at x 838; 8 at x 1058, each in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). In the answer row (centre y 485) the digits, left to right, are: 3 at x 398; 6 at x 618; 4 at x 838; 4 at x 1058, each in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px). A − sign in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px) stands at x 228, y 365, to the left of the second number. In the carry row there are exactly 4 circles: a circle of 64 px diameter outlined green #009E73 (4 px) at x 398, y 178 holding 5; a circle of 64 px diameter outlined green #009E73 (4 px) at x 618, y 178 holding 13; a circle of 64 px diameter outlined green #009E73 (4 px) at x 838, y 178 holding 9; a circle of 64 px diameter outlined green #009E73 (4 px) at x 1058, y 178 holding 12. Each of the four top digits (6, 4, 0 and 2) has a diagonal construction grey line (4 px) struck through it, and the circles hold the regrouped amounts 5 thousands, 13 hundreds, 9 tens and 12 ones.  Under the chart, centred at x 728, y 650, the line 6,402 − 2,758 = 3,644 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (84 px), the largest text in the frame. No other text. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Regroup place by place, even across a zero: 6,402 − 2,758 = 3,644.
images.description: A chart with 6,402 above 2,758, the regroup marks 5, 13, 9 and 12, and the difference 3,644.
images.context: Concept image for Large Numbers: Adding, Then Subtracting, Section B, using the example's own numbers (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Show how the hundreds gave a ten to the tens, and the tens gave one to the ones. The slip to watch: taking the smaller digit from the bigger.

image_decisions.why: One video, two sections, one picture each: the chart for the sum shows the same regrouping steps as small numbers with one more column, and the chart with four regroup marks shows subtracting across a zero.
